headline: Global Tech Stocks Plunge After US Midterm Elections Trigger AI Bubble Fears
summary: Global tech stocks plunged following the Democrats' victory in the US midterm elections. Investors feared an AI slowdown, causing major corporations like Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia to shed about $1 trillion in a single trading session and dragging down European and Asian markets.
why: Major technology companies represent a massive weight in global equity benchmarks. A sudden sell-off in these high-valuation stocks can trigger broader market contagion and alter investor risk appetite worldwide.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Broader tech sector sell-off driven by political shifts and growth slowdown concerns directly pressures high-valuation semiconductor and AI equities.
